review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this pending-decision case. It preserves REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003 and DEC-001, agrees with the original PRD on repository identity and base commit, and correctly requires blocked readiness with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001 after repository, requirements and decisions evidence. Neither conditional acceptance language nor a fixed hypothetical paired input authorizes resolving the human Decision. Empty task and assignment expectations are appropriate because this case must stop at decisions; the empty trusted team catalog and missing later-stage Reviewer therefore do not invalidate this earlier block. The supplied source evidence supports the nine inspection owners, including message construction, normalization and readonly snapshots, option-key filtering, inheritance and public type consumers. Correct generic forwarding and declaration consumers need not be edited. Build configuration establishes distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d type-test location. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree on repository, source, team, decision inputs, prompt versions, metric policy, model, sampling and budgets. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining-work list describe its pre-freeze state; the supplied preview provides the frozen release input. Review independence is supported by the stated absence of candidate runs and historical candidate outputs; retained old-version operations are not treated as current-bundle evidence or copied human attestations. This approval is of the expectation, not execution readiness, implementation correctness or a human policy decision. I reviewed the supplied text only and did not execute code or independently recompute Service-calculated digests.
